summary: The school district urges the FCC to preserve and strengthen the E-Rate program, rejecting any proposal to eliminate or sunset it. The school district expresses opposition to sunsetting the E-Rate program, emphasizing its importance for funding essential connectivity and educational services. They urge the Commission to preserve broad eligibility and maintain support for broadband infrastructure. The school district highlights the critical role of reliable broadband in modern school systems and the potential impact of E-Rate cuts on their ability to provide necessary services to students.
